controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
controles.kjv: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
controles.livre: Olha, eu chamei por seu nome a Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá;

versos.hebraico: וָאֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה וּבִתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

controles.web: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
controles.kjv: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
controles.livre: E o enchi de espírito de Deus, em sabedoria, e em inteligência, e em conhecimento, e em todo artifício,

versos.hebraico: לַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
controles.kjv: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
controles.livre: Para inventar desenhos, para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em bronze,

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

controles.web: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
controles.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
controles.livre: E em artifício de pedras para engastá-las, e em artifício de madeira; para agir em todo tipo de trabalho.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְמַטֵּה־דָ֔ן וּבְלֵ֥ב כָּל־חֲכַם־לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽךָ׃

controles.web: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
controles.kjv: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
controles.livre: E eis que eu pus com ele a Aoliabe, filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã: e pus sabedoria no ânimo de todo sábio de coração, para que façam tudo o que te mandei:

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ת׀ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֶת־הָֽאָרֹן֙ לָֽעֵדֻ֔ת וְאֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־כְּלֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃

controles.web: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the testimony, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
controles.kjv: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
controles.livre: O tabernáculo do testemunho, e a arca do testemunho, e o propiciatório que está sobre ela, e todos os utensílios do tabernáculo;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֥ה הַטְּהֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃

controles.web: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,
controles.kjv: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
controles.livre: E a mesa e seus utensílios, e o candelabro limpo e todos os seus utensílios, e o altar do incenso;

controles.web: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
controles.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
controles.livre: E o altar do holocausto e todos os seus utensílios, e a pia e sua base;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַשְּׂרָ֑ד וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃

controles.web: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest—the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office,
controles.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
controles.livre: E as roupas do serviço, e as santas vestiduras para Arão o sacerdote, e as vestiduras de seus filhos, para que exerçam o sacerdócio;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְאֶת־קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים לַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִ֖ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ

controles.web: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”
controles.kjv: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
controles.livre: E o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático para o santuário: farão conforme tudo o que te mandei.

controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Falou também o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.
controles.kjv: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the Lord that doth sanctify you.
controles.livre: E tu falarás aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Com tudo isso vós guardareis meus sábados: porque é sinal entre mim e vós por vossas gerações, para que saibais que eu sou o SENHOR que vos santifico.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָכֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֨יהָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כָּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בָהּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore; for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
controles.kjv: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
controles.livre: Assim guardareis o sábado, porque santo é a vós: o que o profanar, certamente morrerá; porque qualquer um que fizer obra alguma nele, aquela alma será cortada do meio de seus povos.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Seis dias se fará obra, mas o dia sétimo é sábado de repouso consagrado ao SENHOR; qualquer um que fizer obra no dia do sábado certamente morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
controles.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
controles.livre: Guardarão, pois, o sábado os filhos de Israel: celebrando-o por suas gerações por pacto perpétuo:

versos.hebraico: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃ס

controles.web: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”
controles.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
controles.livre: Sinal é para sempre entre mim e os filhos de Israel; porque em seis dias fez o SENHOR os céus e a terra, e no sétimo dia cessou, e repousou.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֤ר אִתּוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָעֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: He gave to Moses, when he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
controles.kjv: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
controles.livre: E deu a Moisés quando acabou de falar com ele no monte de Sinai, duas tábuas do testemunho, tábuas de pedra escritas com o dedo de Deus.
